note: T110 menu helper: food words for reading menus and asking about dishes. Written by the model (not a native speaker); see docs/research/PHRASES.md (Menu words) before relying on any word. 'flags' mean the food usually contains that (pork, shellfish, nuts, alcohol...); 'meat' is implied by pork, beef and poultry. 'roman' is a pronunciation guide for non-Latin scripts: Hepburn (ja), Hanyu Pinyin with tone marks (zh-Hans, and zh-Hant with Taiwan words, Hong Kong alternatives in brackets), Revised Romanization (ko), simple RTGS without tone marks (th). Regional alternatives are shown in brackets. 'also' holds extra English search words. T112: zh-Hant and id were added in run 98, also by the model; 'toNativeCheck' lists them for a native-speaker check first.
